UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) is a leading global provider of HCM, payroll, HR service delivery and workforce management solutions to tens of thousands of organizations across the world. In 2020, H&F merged Ultimate Software, an investment made in 2019, with Kronos Incorporated, an investment made in 2007.

In 2020, H&F invested in Vantage, a newly formed Bermuda-based commercial property & casualty insurance carrier. The company utilizes technology and analytics to efficiently underwrite business in attractive segments of the commercial insurance market.

description: In 2011, H&F co-led the acquisition of Verisure (Securitas Direct), and, in 2015, became the majority shareholder after acquiring our co-investor’s stake. In 2025, Verisure successfully completed its initial public offering (IPO) on Nasdaq Stockholm, with H&F maintaining its majority share in the business. Verisure is a technology-enabled human services company and a leading provider of professionally monitored alarm systems to residential homes and small businesses in Europe and Latin America. Through its proprietary, industry-leading technology platform, Verisure ensures customer peace of mind by remotely monitoring properties 24 hours, 7 days a week and providing rapid response, when necessary. With over 35 years of insight, experience, and innovation, Verisure’s growth is driven by continuous innovation, category-creating marketing, an efficient go-to-market model and strong customer experience, all underpinned by its customer-centric, “Proud to Protect” culture.

In 2004, H&F acquired Vertafore, a leading provider of specialized software, services and information for the property and casualty insurance industry, including independent agents, brokers, carriers and reinsurers. Vertafore was sold in 2010.

description: In 2012, H&F acquired Wood Mackenzie, a leading global energy and metals industry research and consultancy firm based in Scotland. Wood Mackenzie was sold to Verisk Analytics in 2015.

In 1996, H&F invested as part of a recapitalization in Young & Rubicam (“Y&R”), one of the world’s then largest integrated marketing and communications companies. Y&R completed its initial public offering in 1998 and H&F fully exited its investment in 1999.

In 2022, H&F acquired Zendesk, a leading provider of customer experience software that enables businesses to connect with customers across multiple interaction channels including telephony, chat, email, messaging, social channels, communities, review sites, and help centers. The company’s software serves as a mission-critical system of both record and engagement for customer inquiries, connecting brands with customers worldwide.

In 2021, H&F made an investment in zooplus, a leading online retailer for pet supplies in Europe. Originally founded in Germany, the company operates across Europe and sells products under the shop brands of “zooplus” and “bitiba”. zooplus’ product range includes thousands of food, litter, and accessory items for dogs, cats, and other animals.
